title: Source and evidence record
description: Shape contract for a cited source. The rights fields describe the identified source/resource record; they do not automatically determine rights in scripture text, transcriptions, images, media, or adjacent records. Unknown is a valid explicit assessment state.

inspection_and_limitations.description: What was inspected and what that evidence does not establish.

archive_status.description: Local capture or evidence status, not a claim of textual accuracy.

rights_status.description: Source-specific rights evidence and limits; distinguish this source from any bundled text/media rights.

rights_basis.description: Evidence status supporting the source-level classification; unknown records must state what rights evidence was not established.

local_capture_manifest_url.description: Relative local path to the capture manifest authenticating a retained source snapshot.

local_snapshot_path.description: Relative local path to byte-preserved captured source bytes; render as download-only.
